newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firms, NYMEX up on Nigeria, API data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firms, NYMEX up on Nigeria, API data.

text.p: April Brent crude futures rose more than 20 cents in Asian time after API data showed a large draw in gasoline stocks and in anticipation of a potential strike among Nigerian oil workers.
April Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $19.69 per barrel, up 24 cents from London. One broker said the latest buying interest was coming in from London ahead of the IPE.
"People are worried about the Nigerian situation and the API stats were bullish for products," one broker said.
API data showed a 3.17 million barrel draw in gasoline stocks when a draw of 500,000 barrels had been expected, boosting sentiment that stocks might be too low ahead of the driving season.
Workers of Nigeria's Department of Petroleum Resources, who process export paper, have threatened strike action from Friday over back pay.
NYMEX April crude, which rose 29 cents in New York, was last traded on ACCESS at $21.19, up 19 cents from New York,
